name: 拉科妮莉亚
introduction: Racornelia is a multidisciplinary artist and filmmaker born in Mexico. They were trained in classical dance and music during their childhood. They have been a student of filmmakers such as Victor Erice, Carlos Reygadas, and Amat Escalante; and attended the VFS Screenwriting program through the Latin American Screenwriting Contest, which awarded them a full scholarship. As a Producer, they participated in Rotterdam Lab with her company Enantiodromia. Their film work is intertwined with installation and performance art. Their newest film, MACDO (2025), has been selected for FID Marseille.
